meta.title: Subject Asset & Lease — Anonymized Fact Sheet
meta.privacy_note: PRIVACY: No deal documents, deed, lease, rent roll, appraisal or correspondence were supplied to this engagement. Under the project privacy rules the subject property is identified ONLY by placeholder. No street address, APN, owner name, entity name, loan number, broker/tenant contact, or personal financial data appears anywhere in this repository or on the published site.
meta.schema_note: Row schema, identical to every other data file: id, m (metric), v (value - empty string means left blank/unverified), p (period), s (official source name), u (official URL), k (verified true/false), n (note), optional r (value reported by a non-official source, never used as verified). Placeholder tokens such as [PROPERTY-ID: JIB-CTLA-01] are deliberate anonymisation markers, not values.

Three separate official determinations are outstanding and each requires the parcel location, which is withheld: FEMA flood zone, CAL FIRE / LA County Fire Department Fire Hazard Severity Zone, and Alquist-Priolo Earthquake Fault Zone. The third also creates a statutory seller disclosure duty under Public Resources Code Section 2621.9, so it affects the sell path directly. All three are itemised on the Hazards page at rows H-36 to H-38. FLAG F-07.
